title: AI work patterns
description: See which AI tools helped, what you used them for, and where your workflow could improve.

blocks.title: AI time by tool
blocks.intent: Group active AI-assisted work in the selected period by AI application or tool and return evidence-backed durations in minutes.

blocks.title: What I used AI for
blocks.intent: List the distinct jobs the user used AI to accomplish in the selected period, with the tool, outcome, and specific supporting context.

blocks.title: My usage pattern
blocks.intent: Describe the user's recurring AI usage pattern in the selected period, including when AI was invoked and how it fit into the surrounding workflow.

blocks.title: Where AI helped
blocks.intent: List specific moments in the selected period where AI appears to have accelerated, clarified, or completed useful work. Avoid claiming impact without evidence.

blocks.title: One improvement for tomorrow
blocks.intent: Recommend one small, concrete improvement to the user's AI workflow based on repeated friction or missed leverage observed in the selected period.
